claim_text: 來源機構：Educational Technology Research and Development (Springer)；資料標題：What AI competency do K-12 teachers need? Framework construction based on teachers' work scenarios and the development and validation of a scale；來源刊登日：2026-10-21。作者摘要報告：研究參考 UNESCO〈教師 AI 能力框架〉等，分析中小學教師主要工作情境與 AI 典型應用，建構「AI 基礎能力—AI 應用能力—AI 倫理規範」三維整合框架，應用能力以教學實踐、教育研究與班級經營三情境為核心；量表經文獻回顧、專家訪談、專家效度檢核與預試四階段發展，作者以 18,295 份有效回應進行探索性與驗證性因素分析，最終量表為 22 題。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
source_title: What AI competency do K-12 teachers need? Framework construction based on teachers' work scenarios and the development and validation of a scale
title_zh: 中小學教師需要哪些 AI 能力？依教師工作情境建構框架並發展與驗證量表
source_locator: 出版社文章頁（Springer，2026-10-22 讀取 200）：Published 21 October 2026，citation_online_date 2026/10/21，Crossref published-online 同日；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 3、4、5 句
original_excerpt: Drawing on frameworks and standards such as UNESCO's “AI Competency Framework for Teachers,” this study constructs a three-dimensional integrated framework of “AI foundational competency–AI application competency–AI ethical norms” by analyzing the primary work scenarios of K-12 teachers and typical applications of AI technologies. … Within this framework, Application Competency is anchored in three core scenarios: Teaching Practice, Educational Research, and Classroom Management. … Through four stages—literature review, expert interviews, expert validation, and pilot testing—exploratory and confirmatory factor analyses based on 18,295 valid responses demonstrate that the final 22-item scale exhibits strong reliability and validity.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的框架建構、量表發展階段與樣本數；作者另報告的信效度評語、能力水準與群體差異不寫入。
scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（Educational Technology Research and Development，監測清單 J07）；量表發展與驗證研究，摘要未載樣本國別與抽樣方式，結果不宜推論。

summary_evidence_spans: Drawing on frameworks and standards such as UNESCO's “AI Competency Framework for Teachers,” this study constructs a three-dimensional integrated framework of “AI foundational competency–AI application competency–AI ethical norms” by analyzing the primary work scenarios of K-12 teachers and typical applications of AI technologies.
Within this framework, Application Competency is anchored in three core scenarios: Teaching Practice, Educational Research, and Classroom Management.

Through four stages—literature review, expert interviews, expert validation, and pilot testing—exploratory and confirmatory factor analyses based on 18,295 valid responses demonstrate that the final 22-item scale exhibits strong reliability and validity.

source_title: AI-mediated tools in primary English language education: a scoping review of pedagogical functions and teacher orchestration
title_zh: 國小英語教育中的 AI 中介工具：教學功能與教師統籌之範疇回顧
source_locator: 出版社文章頁（Frontiers，2026-10-22 讀取 200）：Published 21 October 2026（citation_online_date 2026/10/05 為接受日，不採用）；Review 類文章；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 2 至 7 句
original_excerpt: This scoping review followed JBI methodology and PRISMA-ScR. … Scopus, Web of Science Core Collection, and ERIC were searched with a cut-off of 21 September 2026 without publication-year limits. … The synthesis included 119 reports, comprising 72 core empirical reports on primary English education, 31 adjacent empirical reports from related settings and 16 contextual sources. … The synthesis organised the evidence into five recurring pedagogical functions. … These covered oral interaction and speaking rehearsal, pronunciation and oral-reading feedback, and writing, vocabulary, and feedback scaffolding. … They also included reading and multimodal meaning-making and teacher-facing assessment and materials design.

summary_evidence_spans: This scoping review followed JBI methodology and PRISMA-ScR.
Scopus, Web of Science Core Collection, and ERIC were searched with a cut-off of 21 September 2026 without publication-year limits.
The synthesis included 119 reports, comprising 72 core empirical reports on primary English education, 31 adjacent empirical reports from related settings and 16 contextual sources.
The synthesis organised the evidence into five recurring pedagogical functions.
These covered oral interaction and speaking rehearsal, pronunciation and oral-reading feedback, and writing, vocabulary, and feedback scaffolding.
They also included reading and multimodal meaning-making and teacher-facing assessment and materials design.

title_zh: AI 聊天機器人輔助之英語作為外語（EFL）寫作中的寫作動機與自我效能：不同程度學習者的探索性發現

original_excerpt: This study investigated changes in intrinsic motivation, extrinsic motivation, and writing self-efficacy among high school EFL learners at higher- and lower-proficiency levels following chatbot-supported writing and examined whether these changes differed across proficiency levels. … Using an exploratory mixed-methods design, the study involved 47 Vietnamese high school students divided into higher- and lower-proficiency level groups. … Over the 11-week study, participants completed 8 weeks of AI-supported writing activities using a chatbot designed in accordance with principles of Self-Determination Theory, Self-Regulated Learning Theory and Self-Efficacy Theory. … Changes in intrinsic motivation, extrinsic motivation, and writing self-efficacy were examined using pre- and post-questionnaires and semi-structured interviews.

summary_evidence_spans: This study investigated changes in intrinsic motivation, extrinsic motivation, and writing self-efficacy among high school EFL learners at higher- and lower-proficiency levels following chatbot-supported writing and examined whether these changes differed across proficiency levels.
Using an exploratory mixed-methods design, the study involved 47 Vietnamese high school students divided into higher- and lower-proficiency level groups.

Over the 11-week study, participants completed 8 weeks of AI-supported writing activities using a chatbot designed in accordance with principles of Self-Determination Theory, Self-Regulated Learning Theory and Self-Efficacy Theory.
Changes in intrinsic motivation, extrinsic motivation, and writing self-efficacy were examined using pre- and post-questionnaires and semi-structured interviews.

claim_text: 來源機構：Bildungsministerkonferenz der KMK（德國各邦教育部長會議）；資料標題：Was Schülerinnen und Schüler im Umgang mit KI können sollen；來源刊登日：2026-10-16。官方文件表示：德國各邦教育首長更新 KMK〈數位世界中的教育〉能力框架並納入 AI 能力：學生應能理解 AI、有目的、有創意地使用、批判評估其產出並評估機會與風險；原六個能力領域保留，補入批判評估 AI 生成內容與可能偏誤、透明處理 AI 生成或經 AI 處理的作品、資料保護與倫理問題、因應深偽與 AI 強化的假訊息等；緊密參照 OECD 與歐盟執委會的 AI 素養框架。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

title_zh: 學生在使用 AI 方面應具備哪些能力

source_locator: 德國 KMK 新聞稿頁（2026-10-22 讀取 200）：頁面日期 16.10.2026；框架 PDF 同日發布（未引用）；摘要歸屬：第 1 段第 1、2 句，第 3 段第 1、2、4 句
original_excerpt: Die Bildungsministerinnen und Bildungsminister der Länder haben den KMK-Kompetenzrahmen „Bildung in der digitalen Welt“ aktualisiert und um KI-bezogene Kompetenzen erweitert. … Schülerinnen und Schüler sollen Künstliche Intelligenz verstehen, gezielt und kreativ einsetzen, ihre Ergebnisse kritisch bewerten sowie Chancen und Risiken einschätzen können. … Die sechs bestehenden Kompetenzbereiche der KMK-Strategie „Bildung in der digitalen Welt“ bleiben erhalten und werden systematisch um KI-bezogene Kompetenzen ergänzt. … Dazu gehören beispielsweise die kritische Bewertung KI-generierter Inhalte und möglicher Verzerrungen, der transparente Umgang mit KI-generierten oder KI-bearbeiteten Beiträgen, Datenschutz und ethische Fragen sowie der Umgang mit Deepfakes und KI-verstärkter Desinformation. … Der Kompetenzrahmen orientiert sich eng am AI-Literacy-Framework von OECD und Europäischer Kommission.
interpretation_note: 轉述官方新聞稿所載能力框架更新的內容、學生能力要求、補入的能力示例與參照框架；各邦部長的引述與支援工具說明不寫入。

summary_evidence_spans: Die Bildungsministerinnen und Bildungsminister der Länder haben den KMK-Kompetenzrahmen „Bildung in der digitalen Welt“ aktualisiert und um KI-bezogene Kompetenzen erweitert.
Schülerinnen und Schüler sollen Künstliche Intelligenz verstehen, gezielt und kreativ einsetzen, ihre Ergebnisse kritisch bewerten sowie Chancen und Risiken einschätzen können.
Die sechs bestehenden Kompetenzbereiche der KMK-Strategie „Bildung in der digitalen Welt“ bleiben erhalten und werden systematisch um KI-bezogene Kompetenzen ergänzt.

Dazu gehören beispielsweise die kritische Bewertung KI-generierter Inhalte und möglicher Verzerrungen, der transparente Umgang mit KI-generierten oder KI-bearbeiteten Beiträgen, Datenschutz und ethische Fragen sowie der Umgang mit Deepfakes und KI-verstärkter Desinformation.
Der Kompetenzrahmen orientiert sich eng am AI-Literacy-Framework von OECD und Europäischer Kommission.

summary_evidence_spans: Prenderà il via il 19 ottobre il secondo Summit internazionale dedicato all’esplorazione delle potenzialità e delle implicazioni dell’Intelligenza Artificiale nella scuola, promosso dal Ministero dell’Istruzione e del Merito.

Studenti, docenti e dirigenti delle istituzioni scolastiche di tutto il mondo incontreranno esperti di livello internazionale e rappresentanti di istituzioni e imprese per confrontarsi sui temi chiave e sulle applicazioni dell’AI nei sistemi educativi, trasformando il Summit in un grande laboratorio di orientamento, apprendimento e confronto.

In parallelo ai lavori dei docenti e degli studenti, Ministri dell’istruzione, delegati dei ministeri a livello europeo e internazionale, rappresentanti della Commissione europea, dell’OCSE e dell’Unesco si incontreranno per discutere il futuro delle politiche educative nell’era dell’intelligenza artificiale.

Il Summit proseguirà fino al 22 ottobre a Cernobbio, nel centro congressi di Villa Erba, con incontri, laboratori, sessioni formative per docenti e studenti, e momenti di confronto internazionale e con le riunioni delle delegazioni ministeriali internazionali.

original_excerpt: Held at UNESCO Headquarters in Paris on 11 September 2026, convening more than 200 participants, the Strategy Lab tested the DTC's Six Pillars Framework against a fast-moving question: what is AI changing, and is the framework still equipped to respond to these rapid shifts? … The session focused on how education systems can respond to AI’s expanding opportunities and widening gaps, recognising the importance of ethical governance and safety while highlighting the support teachers need to engage critically with the technology as their role evolves. … The concern raised most consistently was whether teachers are equipped with the skills and training to use AI ethically and responsibly while bringing that knowledge into their classroom practice and passing it on to students.

summary_evidence_spans: Held at UNESCO Headquarters in Paris on 11 September 2026, convening more than 200 participants, the Strategy Lab tested the DTC's Six Pillars Framework against a fast-moving question: what is AI changing, and is the framework still equipped to respond to these rapid shifts?

The session focused on how education systems can respond to AI’s expanding opportunities and widening gaps, recognising the importance of ethical governance and safety while highlighting the support teachers need to engage critically with the technology as their role evolves.

The concern raised most consistently was whether teachers are equipped with the skills and training to use AI ethically and responsibly while bringing that knowledge into their classroom practice and passing it on to students.
